name: Cabaretti Courtyard
oracle_text: When this land enters, sacrifice it. When you do, search your library for a basic Mountain, Forest, or Plains card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.
blocked_sentences: When this land enters, sacrifice it. When you do, search your library for a basic Mountain, Forest, or Plains card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.

needs.what: authoring gate 4 accepting a permanent whose own printed enters trigger sacrifices it, so the card ends in the graveyard as printed; the card is expressible today (a self_enters sacrifice of self_only, then a reflexive_trigger that fetches a basic and gains 1 life) and the DSL needs nothing new
needs.why_existing_wont_do: verify._play_once allows a permanent to end only on the battlefield (an Aura also in the graveyard), and tests/cards/test_authoring.py::TestASelfLegalTriggerIsExercisedAgainstTheBoard::test_a_permanent_that_genuinely_vanishes_is_still_rejected pins that a creature whose text is 'When this creature enters, sacrifice it.' must still fail, so widening the gate is a decision for the owner rather than a card fix
